data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 大学阶梯教室的黑板推演
data.description: 空旷的大学学术演讲厅黑板前，写满了复杂的神经科学与相对论公式。红莉栖两指夹着白色粉笔转身回眸，白大褂下是利落干练的天才学者风姿。
data.location: vast university lecture hall with massive slate blackboard filled with chalk equations
data.action: standing at chalkboard holding piece of chalk, turning toward viewer with an arched eyebrow and proud teasing smirk
data.lighting: 高窗斜射的学术阶梯光束
data.promptProse: Kurisu turns from a blackboard dense with theoretical formulas holding chalk, raising an eyebrow with an amused, superior smirk.
data.animaCaption: Chalk dust settles in the afternoon sunbeams as she turns back from the completed equation.
